report.summary: Chunk 9 of embeddings.py: implements journal watermark recording, retrieval, and freshness comparison logic.
risks: record_journal_watermark | high | The method does not validate that spec.index_id exists in the embeddings table before inserting into projection_watermarks; this could lead to orphan watermarks. | Check if _ensure_index(spec) guarantees existence of the index in the embeddings table.

journal_freshness | medium | The method returns 'stale' when recorded.position < observed.position, but does not check content_hash for consistency; a hash mismatch could indicate journal fork without position change. | Add content_hash comparison when positions match to detect forks.

journal_watermark | low | The method returns JournalPosition with content_hash from DB; if content_hash is NULL, it may be misinterpreted as 'no hash' vs 'hash not recorded'. | Ensure that NULL content_hash is handled appropriately by callers.

handoff.purpose: Implement journal watermark recording, retrieval, and freshness comparison for embedding indices.

symbols.name: record_journal_watermark
symbols.note: Inserts or updates a watermark row in projection_watermarks table. Validates against moving backwards and content_hash change at unchanged position.

symbols.name: journal_watermark
symbols.note: Retrieves the watermark for a given index and journal, returning JournalPosition or None.

symbols.name: journal_freshness
symbols.note: Compares index watermark against observed journal position, returning OperationStatus with codes: fresh, stale, journal_forked, unanchored.

claims.text: Refuses to move backwards, and refuses a changed content_hash at an unchanged position - the journal this index derives from is supposed to be append-only, so either would mean the derivation is no longer sound.
claims.why: The code checks if new position < existing position and raises ValueError. It also checks if position unchanged but content_hash differs and raises ValueError.

claims.text: Codes: fresh, stale, journal_forked, unanchored. unanchored means freshness is UNKNOWN - it is never a claim that the index is up to date.
claims.why: The code returns 'unanchored' when observed is None or no watermark exists. The other codes are partially visible: 'journal_forked' when recorded.position > observed.position, 'stale' when recorded.position < observed.position (code truncated but visible). 'fresh' is not in this chunk but is implied by the remaining code.

observations.what: record_journal_watermark does not validate that spec.index_id exists in the embeddings table before inserting into projection_watermarks.
journal_freshness does not check content_hash when positions match; a hash mismatch could indicate journal fork without position change.
The chunk ends mid-function (journal_freshness); the 'fresh' case is not visible.
